text: Your soda can is as thin as a sheet of paper… and it still doesn't burst.
sayTts: [mischievously] Your soda can is as thin as a sheet of paper... and it still doesn't burst.

text: Relax: today I'll show you how it's made.
sayTts: [playfully] Relax: today I'll show you how it's made.

text: A disc, a big stretch, 2,000 a minute… and a fourth step that seals it with the soda inside.
say: A disc, a big stretch, two thousand a minute… and a fourth step that seals it with the soda inside.
sayTts: [curious] A disc, a big stretch, two thousand a minute... and a fourth step that seals it with the soda inside.

text: It starts as a flat aluminum disc: one press, and out pops a little cup.
sayTts: [thoughtful] It starts as a flat aluminum disc: one press... and out pops a little cup.

text: Then it's rammed through rings that stretch it: the wall ends up a tenth of a millimeter.
sayTts: [dramatic] Then it's rammed through rings that stretch it: the wall ends up a tenth of a millimeter.

text: The bottom gets a dome: it holds the pressure like an arch.
sayTts: [thoughtful] The bottom gets a dome: it holds the pressure... like an arch.

text: And inside, a thin lining: your soda never touches the aluminum.
sayTts: [amazed] And inside, a thin lining: your soda never touches the aluminum.

text: Someone asked: how do they get the soda in if it's already closed?
sayTts: [sarcastic] Someone asked: how do they get the soda in if it's already closed?

comment.question: How do they get the soda in if the can's already closed? 🥤

text: It isn't: they fill it first, then seam the lid on in a split second.
sayTts: [chuckles] It isn't: they fill it first... then seam the lid on in a split second.

text: That's the fourth step: the gas pushes from inside and makes it rock hard.
sayTts: [excited] That's the fourth step: the gas pushes from inside... and makes it rock hard.

text: Tag your friend who always shakes the can before handing it over.
sayTts: [excited] Tag your friend who always shakes the can... before handing it over.

text: See you next time! Hit like and follow for more.
sayTts: [warmly] See you next time! Hit like and follow for more.
